review_candidates.description: Infrastructure Engineer | Sydney | Network / Bare Metal / Ansible I'm working with a Sydney-based deep-tech company whose products are commercially deployed and generating revenue, and they need an Infrastructure Engineer to own the physical and network layer that the business runs on. On-prem compute, storage, and the fabric connecting it all, plus a compute cluster that ships alongside every piece of hardware the company builds. Infrastructure Engineer Responsibilities Design and run network engineering across layers 2 and 3, VLANs, subnetting, routing, link aggregation and firewall policy. Rack, cable and commission physical hardware end to end, then hand it over provisioned and reproducible through code rather than configured by hand. Run Kubernetes on hardware the team owns directly. Handle firmware and BMC level work through IPMI or Redfish. Bring infrastructure as code into the buildout process wherever it replaces manual, one-off configuration. Strong Ansible depth, structuring real playbook estates rather than one-off scripts. Comfortable designing and troubleshooting at layer 2 and 3, VLANs, routing protocols, link aggregation, firewall and ACL policy. Infrastructure as code beyond configuration management, Terraform, OpenTofu or similar. Production Kubernetes experience on owned hardware. Specific vendor platform or provisioning tooling isn't a gate, strong underlying network and automation depth picks up a new toolchain fast. Exposure to high-throughput fabrics, network automation or source-of-truth tooling, and repeatable multi-site buildouts including remote or air-gapped locations are all a bonus. This is a full-time role based in Sydney - if interested, please apply with your most up-to-date resume & I'll be in touch.
